                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A system of linear equations has a unique solution if the ratio of the coefficients of x is not equal to the ratio of the coefficients of y.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Comparing 4ax + 3by = c and 3cx + 2dy = a, we check the ratio: 4a/3c ≠ 3b/2d.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Cross-multiplying gives: 4a × 2d ≠ 3c × 3b ⇒ 8ad ≠ 9bc.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is 8ad ≠ 9bc.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                First Equation: 4ax + 3by = c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Second Equation: 3cx + 2dy = a

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For two equations a1x + b1y = c1 and a2x + b2y = c2, the condition for a unique solution is:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a1/a2 ≠ b1/b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Comparing the given equations with standard form:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a1 = 4a, b1 = 3b

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a2 = 3c, b2 = 2d

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Applying the condition: (4a) / (3c) ≠ (3b) / (2d)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 4a × 2d ≠ 3b × 3c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 8ad ≠ 9bc

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is 8ad ≠ 9bc.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Infinite Solutions Condition

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A system has infinitely many solutions if the ratios of all coefficients are equal: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                No Solution Condition

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A system has no solution (inconsistent) if a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2, representing parallel lines.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Consistency

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                A system is called consistent if it has at least one solution (either unique or infinite) and inconsistent if it has no solution. Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                रैखिक समीकरणों के एक निकाय का एक अद्वितीय हल (unique solution) होता है यदि x के गुणांकों का अनुपात y के गुणांकों के अनुपात के बराबर नहीं होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4ax + 3by = c और 3cx + 2dy = a की तुलना करने पर, हम अनुपात की जाँच करते हैं: 4a/3c ≠ 3b/2d.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                तिर्यक गुणा (Cross-multiplying) करने पर प्राप्त होता है: 4a × 2d ≠ 3c × 3b ⇒ 8ad ≠ 9bc.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ सही उत्तर 8ad ≠ 9bc है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                पहला समीकरण: 4ax + 3by = c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दूसरा समीकरण: 3cx + 2dy = a

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दो समीकरणों a1x + b1y = c1 और a2x + b2y = c2 के लिए, एक अद्वितीय हल के लिए शर्त है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                a1/a2 ≠ b1/b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ दिए गए समीकरणों की मानक रूप से तुलना करने पर:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a1 = 4a, b1 = 3b

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a2 = 3c, b2 = 2d

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ शर्त लागू करने पर: (4a) / (3c) ≠ (3b) / (2d)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 4a × 2d ≠ 3b × 3c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 8ad ≠ 9bc

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ सही उत्तर 8ad ≠ 9bc है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                अनंत हलों की शर्त (Infinite Solutions Condition)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                एक निकाय के अनंत हल होते हैं यदि सभी गुणांकों का अनुपात बराबर हो: a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                कोई हल नहीं होने की शर्त (No Solution Condition)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                एक निकाय का कोई हल नहीं होता (असंगत) यदि a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2, जो समांतर रेखाओं को दर्शाता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                संगति (Consistency)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                एक निकाय को संगत (consistent) कहा जाता है यदि इसका कम से कम एक हल (या तो अद्वितीय या अनंत) हो और असंगत (inconsistent) कहा जाता है यदि इसका कोई हल न हो।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n148:T848,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇచ్చిన దత్తాంశం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                4ax + 3by = c

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                3cx + 2dy = a

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన కాన్సెప్ట్:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                సమీకరణం a1x + b1y = c1 మరియు a2x + b2y = c2 ప్రత్యేక సాధనలను కలిగి ఉంటాయి

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఒకవేళ, ఇచ్చిన దత్తాంశం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                సమీకరణం a1x + b1y = c1 మరియు a2x + bदिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                जर, a1/a2 ≠ b1/b2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रश्नानुसार,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ a1 = 4a, b1 = 3b

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 8ad ≠ 9cb

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ योग्य उत्तर 8ad ≠ 9bc आहे.

"correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For a fixed Selling Price (₹1), the Quantity is inversely proportional to the Price percentage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Product Constant Rule: Q1 × SP%1 = Q2 × SP%2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Here, SP%1 = 100 − 40 = 60% and SP%2 = 100 + 20 = 120%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                32 × 60 = Q2 × 120

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Q2 = (32 × 60) ÷ 120 = 16.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is 16 lemons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Initial Quantity (Q1) = 32 lemons

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Initial Loss = 40%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Target Profit = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Total Selling Price = ₹1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                SP = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss%)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Selling Price of 1 lemon (at 40% loss) = ₹1/32

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 1/32 = Cost Price × (100 − 40)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ 1/32 = Cost Price × 60/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Cost Price of 1 lemon = 1/32 × 100/60 = 5/96

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ New Selling Price (to gain 20% profit) = (5/96) × (100 + 20)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ New SP per lemon = 5/96 × 120/100 = 5/96 × 6/5 = 1/16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ⇒ Total Lemons to be sold for ₹1 = 1 ÷ (1/16) = 16

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The correct answer is 16 lemons.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Inverse Variation in SP

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When the total amount spent or received is constant, the quantity of items is inversely proportional to the price per item.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Successive Percentage Change

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the effective change is [a + b + (a × b)/100]%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                CP, SP, and MP Relation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The relationship between Cost, Marked, and Selling price is given by: SP = CP × (1 + P/100) = MP × (1 − D/100).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mother

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                to B

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Statement given : N & P – Q + T × R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • N & P → N is the wife of P.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • P – Q → P is the father of Q.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Q + T → Q is the mother of T.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • T × R → T is the brother of R.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Thus, according to the final family tree N is the maternal grandmother i.e mother's mother of R.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Hence, "Mother’s mother" is the correct answer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                दिया गया कथन : N & P – Q + T × R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                इसलिए,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • N & P → N, P की पत्नी है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • P – Q → P, Q का पिता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Q + T → Q, T की माता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • T × R → T, R का भाई है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                इस प्रकार, अंतिम वंश वृक्ष के अनुसार N, R की नानी अर्थात माता की माता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                अतः सही उत्तर "नानी" है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n175:T117c,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                B యొక్క

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఇవ్వబడ్డ ప్రకటన : N & P – Q + T × R

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                కాబట్టి,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • N & P →  N అనేది P యొక్క భార్య.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • P – Q → P అనేది  Q యొక్క తండ్రి.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Q + T → Q అనేది T యొక్క తల్లి.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • T × R → T అనేది R యొక్క సోదరుడు.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ​

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                అందువలన, తుది కుటుంబ వృక్షం ప్రకారం N అనేది అమ్మమ్మ అంటే R యొక్క తల్లి యొక్క తల్లి.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                అందుకే 'తల్లి యొక్క తల్లి' అనేది సరైన సమాధానం.
