                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                स्पष्टीकरण

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                एक लोकोमोटिव के संचालन में, इंजन पर भार कभी भी स्थिर नहीं रहता है। यह ट्रेन के वजन, ट्रैक के Which one of above is not a type of bearing failure/defect?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span>Split line fretting</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span>creep/back fretting</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span>Static fretting</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span>Electromagnetic fretting</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा बेयरिंग की विफलता/दोष का प्रकार नहीं है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span>स्प्लिट लाइन फ्रेटिंग (Split line fretting)</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span>क्रीप/बैक फ्रेटिंग (creep/back fretting)</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span>स्टैटिक फ्रेटिंग (Static fretting)</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span>विद्युतचुंबकीय फ्रेटिंग (Electromagnetic fretting)</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Bearing failures are generally classified into groups based on the nature of damage, such as fatigue, wear, corrosion, and electrical erosion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Fretting is a specialized form of wear that occurs at the contact interface of two materials under load when subjected to low-amplitude oscillatory motion or vibration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In the context of sleeve and rolling element bearings, fretting can manifest in several specific ways depending on the location of the relative movement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \nExplanation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The following are recognized types of bearing defects related to fretting and movement:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Split line fretting: This occurs at the parting surfaces or प्रमुख बिंदु

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • बेयरिंग विफलताएं (Bearing failures) को आम तौर पर क्षति की प्रकृति के आधार पर समूहों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है, जैसे कि थकान (fatigue), घिसाव (wear), संक्षारण (corrosion) और विद्युत क्षरण (electrical erosion)।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • फ्रेटिंग (Fretting) घिसाव का एक विशिष्ट रूप है जो भार के तहत दो सामग्रियों के संपर्क इंटरफेस पर तब होता है जब वे कम-आयाम वाले दोलनी गति या कंपन के अधीन होते हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • स्लीव और रोलिंग एलिमेंट बेयरिंग के संदर्भ में, सापेक्ष गति के स्थान के आधार पर फ्रेटिंग कई विशिष्ट तरीकों से प्रकट हो सकती है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  स्पष्टीकरण

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  फ्रेटिंग और गति से संबंधित बेयरिंग दोषों के मान्यता प्राप्त प्रकार निम्नलिखित हैं:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • स्प्लिट लाइन फ्रेटिंग (Split line fretting): यह बेयरिंग शेल्स की विभाजन सतहों या स्प्लिट लाइन्स (split lines) पर होता है। यह बेयरिंग हाउसिंग या शेल के दोनों हिस्सों के बीच सूक्ष्म-हलचल के कारण होता है जब वे पूरी तरह से सुरक्षित नहीं होते हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • क्रीप या बैक फ्रेटिंग (Creep or Back fretting): यह बेयरिंग शेल के बाहरी व्यास (बैक) या हाउसिंग बोर पर होता है। यह तब होता है जब अपर्याप्त इंटरफेरेंस फिट होता है, जिससे ऑपरेशन के दौरान बेयरिंग अपनी सीट के भीतर थोड़ा हिलती या खिसकती (creep) है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • स्टैटिक फ्रेटिंग (Static fretting): इसे फॉल्स ब्रिनेलिंग (false brinelling) के रूप में भी जाना जाता है, यह तब होता है जब बेयरिंग स्थिर होती है लेकिन बाहरी कंपनों के अधीन होती है। यह कंपन रोलिंग एलिमेंट्स को लुब्रिकेंट फिल्म को घिसने और रेसवे को नुकसान पहुंचाने का कारण बनता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • विद्युतचुंबकीय फ्रेटिंग (Electromagnetic fretting): यह बेयरिंग विफलता के लिए कोई मान्यता प्राप्त तकनीकी शब्द नहीं है। हालांकि विद्युत प्रवाह के गुजरने के कारण बेयरिंग विफल हो सकती है (एक घटना जिसे इलेक्ट्रिकल डिस्चार्ज मशीनिंग या विद्युत क्षरण के रूप में जाना जाता है जिसके परिणामस्वरूप बांसुरीनुमा निशान या गर्त बनते हैं), लेकिन विद्युतचुंबकीय फ्रेटिंग के रूप में वर्गीकृत कोई विशिष्ट दोष नहीं है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  इसलिए, सही उत्तर विद्युतचुंबकीय फ्रेटिंग (Electromagnetic fretting) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n28e:T961,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concept

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The fuel oil system of an Alco Locomotive is designed to provide a continuous and clean supply of fuel to the engine at a specific pressure.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Cleanliness of fuel is critical because the Fuel Injection Pumps (FIP) and injectors are precision-engineered components that can be easily damaged by microscopic contaminants.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • To achieve the required level of purity, the system incorporates different stages of filtration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \nImportant Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  In a standard Alco Locomotive (such as the WDM2 or WDM3A), the filtration process is divided into two distinct stages:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Primary Fuel Filter: This assembly is usually located on the suction side of the fuel transfer pump. It acts as the first line of defense, removing relatively larger particles of dirt and debris from the fuel tank before the fuel enters the pump. It typically uses felt or cotton yarn as the filtering medium.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Secondary Fuel Filter: This assembly is located on the discharge side of the fuel transfer pump, positioned between the pump and the fuel header. It uses high-efficiency paper-type filter elements to trap very fine particles that may have passed through the primary filter, ensuring only clean fuel reaches the engine cylinders.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \nConclusion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The fuel oil system in Alco Locomotives is equipped with two separate filter assemblies to ensure reliable operation and protection of the engine's fuel injection equipment.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Hence, the number of filter assemblies provided in the fuel oil system is two.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n28f:T13b9,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Concept:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    A turbocharger is a centrifugal compressor powered by a turbine that is driven by an engine's exhaust gases. Its primary purpose is to increase the mass of air entering the cylinders to allow for more fuel combustion. The turbine side is exposed to high-velocity, high-temperature exhaust gases, necessitating specialized components and materials to ensure durability and performance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Given

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Component: Inlet casing of a turbocharger.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Material property: Heat resistant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Calculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The identification of the component is based on its function and location within the turbocharger system:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    1. The turbine section of the turbocharger receives hot exhaust gases directly from the engine manifold. The part that houses this entry point is the Gas inlet casing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    2. Because the temperature of exhaust gases in diesel or petrol engines can range from 500°C to over 900°C, the Gas inlet casing must be constructed from heat-resistant materials such as high-grade cast iron, ductile iron, or nickel-alloy steels to prevent thermal cracking and deformation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    3. In contrast, a suction strainer is used on the cold air intake side (compressor) to filter out debris, and an accumulator is a pressure vessel for fluid storage, neither of which requires the specific heat-resistant casing design described in the question.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    4. Therefore, the component designed to receive hot gases and made of heat-resistant material is the gas inlet casing.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Final Answer: ✅ Gas inlet casing

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    సరైన పఠనం = (కాలిపర్ పఠనం) - (+శూన్య లోపం)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ధనాత్మక శూన్య లోపం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ధనాత్మక శూన్య లోపం అనేది థింబల్ స్కేల్ యొక్క '0' మార్కింగ్ ప్రధాన స్కేల్ యొక్క క్షితిజ సమాంతర సూచన రేఖకు దిగువన ఉన్నప్పుడు సంభవిస్తుంది. పఠనాన్ని సరిచేయడానికి, మేము కొలత నుండి లోపాన్ని తీసివేస్తాము.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    సరైన పఠనం = (కాలిపర్ పఠనం) - (-శూన్య లోపం)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\rm సరైన \\;పఠనం = కాలిపర్ \\;పఠనం\\;-\\;(\\pm\\;శూన్య\\;లోపం)\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ధనాత్మక శూన్య లోపం = +0.02 మి.మీ, గమనించిన పఠనం = 25.41 మి.మీ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \\(\\rm సరైన \\;పఠనం = కాలిపర్ \\;పఠనం\\;-\\;(\\pm\\;శూన్య\\;లోపం)\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    సరైన పఠనం = 25.41 - (+0.02) = 25.39 మి.మీ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    नकारात्मक शून्य त्रुटी (Negative Zero Error):

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • नकारात्मक शून्य त्रुटी तेव्हा उद्भवते जेव्हा थिंबल स्केलचे '0' चिन्ह मुख्य स्केलच्या क्षैतिज संदर्भ रेषेच्या वर असते. त्रुटी +x मिमी असते. रीडिंग दुरुस्त करण्यासाठी, आपण मापनातून त्रुटी वजा करतो.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ ದೋಷ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ತಿಂಬಲ್ ಮಾಪಕದ '0' ಗುರುತು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮಾಪಕದ ಸಮತಲ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ರೇಖೆಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ ದೋಷ ಸಂಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೋಷವು +x ಮಿಮೀ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಓದುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಲು, ನಾವು ಅಳತೆಯಿಂದ ದೋಷವನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ ದೋಷ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ತಿಂಬಲ್ ಮಾಪಕದ '0' ಗುರುತು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಮಾಪಕದ ಸಮತಲ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ರೇಖೆಗಿಂತ ಮೇಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಶೂನ್ಯ ದೋಷ ಸಂಭವಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ದೋಷವು +x ಮಿಮೀ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಓದುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಲು, ನಾವು ಅಳತೆಯಿಂದ ದೋಷವನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Concept

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The Moatti filter is an advanced automatic back-flushing filter system extensively used in diesel locomotives.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Its primary role is to ensure the continuous and efficient filtration of lubricating oil (lube oil) to protect the internal engine components from wear and tear.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Unlike conventional filters that require manual cleaning or frequent replacement, the Moatti filter cleans itself during operation using the pressure of the oil itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nKey Features

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The Moatti filter assembly consists of several filter elements made of fine mesh. The key features include:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Continuous Filtration: It provides uninterrupted lube oil flow to the engine components even during the cleaning cycle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Automatic Cleaning: It uses a hydraulic motor driven by the oil flow to rotate a distributor, which triggers the back-flushing mechanism.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Impurity Removal: It effectively removes carbon soot, metal particles, and other contaminants from the lubricating system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nImportance in Locomotives

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In heavy-duty Diesel Locomotives, the lube oil is critical for cooling and lubricating the crankshaft, bearings, and pistons. If the oil is not filtered properly:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Abrasive particles can cause seizure of moving parts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The engine efficiency decreases due to increased friction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Maintenance costs increase significantly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      By providing the Moatti filter, the locomotive ensures that the Lube Oil remains within the required purity standards for a longer duration, thereby extending the engine life and reducing the frequency of oil changes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Hence, the purpose of providing the Moatti filter at locomotives is the filtration of lube oil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Therefore, the correct option is 1.
